name: Molecular Weight Calculator
description: Calculate molar mass and elemental mass contributions from chemical formulas in your browser, preserving the TMCCDB formula parser and atomic weights.
features: Element counts, atomic weights, mass contributions and mass percentages
Positive integer or decimal stoichiometry and nested parentheses
Hydrate dot notation is unsupported; ASCII periods denote decimal counts

history.notes: Added the TMCCDB molecular weight calculator to AimatraLab, preserving its formula parsing and elemental results.

zh.description: 在浏览器中由化学式计算摩尔质量及各元素质量贡献，保留 TMCCDB 的化学式解析器和原子量数据。
features: 在浏览器本地计算摩尔质量
展示元素数量、原子量、质量贡献和质量百分比
支持正整数或小数计量数及嵌套圆括号
不支持水合物点号写法；英文句点表示小数计量数

historyNotes.1.0.0: 将 TMCCDB 分子量计算器接入 AimatraLab，保留原有化学式解析与元素结果。
